g.text: Figure 1: CAMS describes past sunshine best of the six products tested

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each product's own mean absolute error, sorted best first. Figure 2 shows the paired contrasts, which test whether a gap is statistically significant: shared weather noise makes these intervals overlap more than a paired difference does. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026.'
